title: Audit QQ16 integer consumer incidence and conditional budget
body:
A module placed once at each first B1 cut has **16 proposed insertion sites across 144 local calls**, a rate of **1/9**, rather than the earlier pair rate of 1/2. This source-bound audit reconstructs the complete frozen hosted schedule and the corresponding nine-word QQ16 producer profile. The profile adds 136 H1 per replica (credited to Nick Petalas / [PR #3339](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3339)), giving mean `n1 = 2412 + 136/9`.

This changes the conditional budget decision: retaining the favorable assumptions `W=896/9`, centre64 and ideal rank 51 idle completion, a 336-H1 module at that rate has `G` in `[0.999977964672213086, 0.999977964672213087]`. The strict integer native-module cap is 553 H1; 554 fails. The old pair-rate rejection therefore does not transport to this placement proposal.

The source contains **zero actual [PR #3952](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3952) invocations**: all 144 calls still use `gauge44`. Sixteen counts proposed insertion sites, not proved consumer demands. The 482-event ledger identifies every relevant family/readset, the first missing provider connection, subsequent bridge/F2/terminal events and conditional output-retention peaks. It also checks that simply appending the projection's cleared output slots does not preserve arbitrary productive input under the selected family contract.

Scope is the frozen frontier [PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042)-lineage hosted template, with selected frontier [PR #1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) kappa only as an arithmetic target. No QQ16 substitution, productive-family coverage transport, displaced idle credit, physical hosting or new kappa is admitted. The package has no executable or scientific dependency on the other parallel follow-ups. Parameter cases 208/224/304 are arithmetic values, not certifications of sibling candidates.

Validation on Python 3.12.3:

- Normal and optimized exact replay reproduce the complete typed RESULT.
- Seven optimized control groups cover provider/incidence/frame/family mutations, native rank and duplicate centre credit, reads before owned dirt is cleared, typed receipt mutations, source/manifests, and the 553/554 boundary.
- Minimal Git-free, read-only exports pass normal and optimized replay without changing file bytes.
- Registered package metadata/pins and full registered replay pass.
- Separate AI cross-review independently checked the 16/144 census, 384/1536 retention peaks, complete nine-stage profile, exact arithmetic and scope. Coordinating AI review found no substantive blocker. This is not human or proof-assistant review.

The published commit and source-history/byte preflight are reported below. Complete evidence, excluded obligations and next-step contract are in `research/qq16-consumer-incidence/PROOF.md`, `RESULT.json`, `VERIFICATION.json`, and `REVIEWS.json`.
